title: AMRK-DB: a stability-filtered, lineage-validated, unitig-resolution AMR biomarker Knowledge Base for Escherichia coli
description:
AMRK-DB is a queryable, confidence-tiered, FAIR knowledge base of machine-learning-derived genomic biomarkers of antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in Escherichia coli. Unitig (compacted de Bruijn graph) presence/absence features are ranked by XGBoost, filtered for reproducibility with Complementary Pairs Stability Selection (CPSS, B=100, π≥0.6, PFER-bounded) and lineage-aware cross-validation (PopPUNK + GroupKFold), then reverse-translated into biology via CARD/NCBI BLAST confidence tiering, ARO ontology mapping, resistant-vs-susceptible discriminativeness (Fisher + BH-FDR), CARD variant-model SNP allele checks, MDA/label permutation tests, and pyseer LMM population-structure-corrected significance. Every record carries full provenance (git commit, seed, config hash, CARD version) in a pipeline_runs table.

This deposit contains the SQLite knowledge base (amrk.db, schema 0.4.0) plus the per-antibiotic candidate/evidence tables and run metadata. Raw genome assemblies are obtained from BV-BRC; the full pipeline reproduces the unitig matrices from those assemblies. Statistical association is not biological causation (confidence tiers are evidence, not mechanism claims).
